text: hi im really not sure if im being daft messageing about this but im looking after my neice tonight shes 4 and about an hour ago she was running round and banged her head on the corner of the coffee table. she cried straight away like proper screamed which i think is a good sign? and i gave her a cuddle and some ice wrapped in a tea towel and within about ten minuets she was back to normal, shes been playing with her dolls and chatting away and asked for a snack and everything, honestly shes acting completly like herself. theres a little red mark where she hit it. my sister is away til tomorow and i just dont want to get it wrong and have her come back and be like why didnt you check. is there anything i should be watching for overnight or am i fine to just put her to bed like normal
